notes: GRand::GameFloatRand(scale, file, line): a 2000-draw sequence from seed 0x88F89F (chain). scale == 0 (fcomp with 0x8AA398) returns 0 without a draw, else GData::FloatRand 0x5106B0: LHRand(0xFFFF) as an integer x scale x 0x37800080 (~1/65535), at 24-bit precision. ret_f32 is what a caller stores. openblack: game_random::FloatRand.
